appliedUpdates.description: Documented that Ctrl+K is intercepted by xterm terminal when focused — use 'Open command palette' button instead for VAL-GUI-006

Documented that settings page form fields are only visible when desktopEnvironment is non-null (provided by server bootstrap). In web mode with server running, desktopEnvironment is populated from the DesktopEnvironmentService.

Documented that manually started backend server (outside Playwright test lifecycle) is unstable and crashes during node operations. Playwright tests manage their own server lifecycle via shared-setup.ts and work reliably.

validationMethods.agentBrowser: Used for VAL-GUI-001 through VAL-GUI-011 (interactive browser testing with screenshots)
validationMethods.playwright: Used for VAL-GUI-012 confirmation (36/36 GUI tests pass including node deletion tests)
validationMethods.combined: VAL-GUI-012 was blocked in agent-browser due to server instability but confirmed passing via Playwright E2E tests (e2e/gui/node-lifecycle.spec.ts: 6/6 tests pass including 'node can be deleted via REPL and disappears from canvas' and 'deleted node disappears from explorer panel')
